<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex45042026-09-1606-03-19" status="unreviewed"><lb n="N002"/><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3892">chos kyi rje pa'i d chen po</rs>s <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5564">rigs pa'i gter</rs> las de ltar sgrub dang dun gyi | rigs pi ba zhung lung bang gi pa shes | mkhas pa de ni rdzogs pa yi | sargyas rnams kyi bstan pa 'ji+en || rtag kyi sprul ba'i rgyu 'gal 'brel nges par bya ba la 2e dang po 'gal 'brel nges par bye bongs pi rgyun dagg dang sgrub pa ri steng pa
               <lb n="N003"/>lag pa 'brel nyid la ltos pas na | tshad ma'i mchod dpyod pa yi | sngon du 'ba la 'brel nges par bya || cesungs pa lto |</seg></TEI>
